### Be Like the Bereans - Crosswalk the Devotional - March 20, 2013
Author: Anna Kuta
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/be-like-the-bereans-crosswalk-the-devotional-march-21-2012.html
Passage: Acts 17:10-11
Points:
- The Bereans welcomed Paul and Silas with openness rather than the hostility seen in Thessalonica.
- They diligently searched the Scriptures every day instead of just accepting human claims.
- Discovering that the message of Christ aligned with God's word led many to believe.
- Modern Christians must test all teaching against the Bible to guard against false doctrines.

### Chapter-and-Verse Protestants: The Reformation Legacy of Little Berea
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/chapter-and-verse-protestants
Passage: Acts 17:11-12
Points:
- Luke commends the Bereans for receiving the gospel message with earnest hunger and openness.
- Their eagerness took the form of persistent, daily investigation of the Scriptures.
- Rather than relying on secondary Jewish traditions or assumptions, they checked God's written word.
- Believers must make daily personal study and biblical testing an ongoing practice.
